name: Richmond
seat: Richmond (independent city — belongs to no county)

jurisdictions.name: City of Richmond
jurisdictions.governing_body: Richmond City Council (9 districts) with an elected Mayor

quorum_court.source: Richmond is one of Virginia’s 38 independent cities — it belongs to no county and performs county-level functions itself (its own courts, sheriff, jail, and constitutional officers). It has a strong-mayor form: an elected Mayor plus a nine-member City Council and a separately-elected School Board.

budget_adoption_window.note: The Mayor proposes in March and City Council adopts in May; the fiscal year begins July 1.

election_blackouts.note: Bright lines: no candidate issues, no active-ballot-measure issues, no named-individual conduct issues.
